words.definition: adj. 短暂的，短时间的；简短的，简洁的 n. 摘要，简报；案情摘要 v. 向...介绍情况，向...下达指示
examples: Let me give you a brief overview of the project.
The meeting was very brief, lasting only ten minutes.

words.definition: n. 简洁，简短；短暂，短促
collocations: brevity is the soul of wit
examples: Brevity is the soul of wit.
The report was notable for its brevity.
words.etymology: 来自拉丁语 brevis（短的）+ -ty 后缀
